description: Per-type constraints when registering institution links: 20-item caps for cards, bank accounts, PG MIDs and delivery stores, PG key sets per PG company, refused CF_ Toss MIDs, ID/PW-only corporate cards, speed-bank-only banks, certificate-only Giro without storing Giro credentials, and hometax ID (lookup only) vs certificate (issuing).

inputSchema.type: IntegrationType being registered: hometax | cardsales | creditcard | bank | speedbank | giro | pg | delivery.
inputSchema.existing: Count of items (cards, accounts, PG MIDs, stores) already registered for the type, or existing links.
inputSchema.request: Registration body in legacy wire terms: auth {account_id, account_pw} or {cert_id, sign_pw}; pg {pg_company, mid, keys}; delivery {delivery_corp}; card/bank {codes, is_corporate, selected}.

cases.name: bank: 19 accounts registered, adding 1 is accepted
bank: 19 accounts registered, adding 2 exceeds 20
creditcard: selecting only already registered cards is refused
creditcard: ID login with two card companies at once is refused

expected.reason: ID login covers one institution at a time

cases.name: creditcard: corporate 하나·롯데·삼성 cards only via ID/PW

expected.manual: 하나/롯데/삼성 법인 카드의 경우에는 인증서 연동을 지원하지 않기 때문에, ID/PW 로그인 방식으로만 연동이 가능합니다.

cases.name: pg: TOSSPAYMENTS MID starting with CF_ is refused
pg: CF_ prefix on another PG company is not checked
pg: NAVERPAY needs settlement_api_key, client_id, client_secret and chain_id
pg: NICEPAY needs usr_id and merchant_key; secret keys are masked in responses
pg: same PG company with a second MID (단건 + 정기) is a separate link
pg: same PG company and MID again is a conflict
pg: 20 MIDs registered, the 21st is refused
delivery: account whose stores are all registered is a conflict
delivery: certificate login is not accepted
giro: ID/PW login is refused, a certificate is required
giro: giro_id/giro_pw passed for signup or first login are not stored
hometax: ID/PW link allows lookup only
hometax: certificate link allows tax invoice issuing and may coexist with an ID link
hometax: second ID link is a conflict
speedbank: 신한은행 registers through the speed lookup account, not internet banking ID

openQuestions: The 20-item cap is counted per item kind in legacy (cards, accounts, stores) but per link for PG, and whether inactive or deleted items count is not specified.
Which corporate card companies are ID/PW-only (하나·롯데·삼성 per the manual) and which banks are speed-lookup-only are manual text, not codes in the bundle; the legacy server enforces neither.
The CF_ restriction is described for Cafe24-issued Toss Payments MIDs; whether TOSSPAY or UPLUS MIDs can also start with CF_ is unknown.
Whether the hometax ID/PW of 세무신고 기관 연동 and the hometax ID link of 내역 수집 기관 연동 are the same record is unknown.
NICEPAY and INICIS need the fixed egress IP 52.78.5.241 whitelisted at the PG; the server cannot verify that before the first reconciliation call.
Legacy registration calls the scraping vendor synchronously with a 120s timeout; whether registration should become an asynchronous job is open.
